fact: A 14 October 2025 report says that once a newborn is added to the civil registry with the computerised birth certificate, an identity file is opened in the civil status database and a national number is allocated from birth, with the card issued only from age sixteen.
title: كيفية إصدار بطاقة الرقم القومي للمواليد الجدد 2025.. الدليل الكامل للتسجيل
